title: Business Office Standard — Released Payment-Plan Balances in the Final-Notice Paydown Base, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Standard.** On the Patient Financial Account, a defaulted payment plan's released balance is left out of the paydown base of a final-notice paydown while the plan can still be reinstated — that is, while the plan's default date is no more than its tier's reinstatement window, in calendar days, before the handling date:

- for a Financial Hardship Plan, the whole released balance is left out;
- for any other plan tier, the released balance less the reinstatement payment is left out, the reinstatement payment being the tier's number of reinstatement-payment installments multiplied by the plan's installment amount (and nothing is left out where the reinstatement payment is the larger);
- once the reinstatement window has closed, nothing is left out.

The paydown base is the balance of the account's most recent statement less the part left out, and is never below 0.00.

**Records read (Patient Payment Plans).** The plan in defaulted status; its tier (plan type); its default date; its installment amount; the balance-released entries on its ledger; and, for its tier, the reinstatement window in calendar days and the number of installments that make up the reinstatement payment, as set by Patient Payment Plans.

## Determinations

| Defaulted plan, default date within the tier's reinstatement window | Plan tier | Left out of the paydown base |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Financial Hardship Plan | the whole released balance |
| yes | any other tier | released balance less the reinstatement payment |
| no — the window has closed | any | nothing |
| no defaulted plan with a released balance | — | nothing |

**Boundary.** With a (hypothetical) 30-day reinstatement window and a default dated day 0, the plan can still be reinstated on day 30 and cannot on day 31.

**Hypothetical worked figures.** Most recent statement 900.00. A defaulted 12-Month Interest-Free Plan inside its window, released balance 600.00, installment amount 100.00, and a tier reinstatement payment of 2 installments: the reinstatement payment is 200.00, so 400.00 is left out and the paydown base is 500.00. Were the plan a Financial Hardship Plan, 600.00 would be left out and the base would be 300.00.
